scope: Fourth immutable snapshot plus current worktree comparison. No source edits, Cargo, Windows, CI or network execution. Source conclusions only, not test/build/runtime PASS.

facts.finding: Actual --repair calls reinitialize_application::run; no-argument manual and --autostart call application::run(false/true). Both run functions now invoke installation_startup::run before any DataPaths::program_data lookup.

Trusted current-user identity is discovered, physical shared gate acquired and Pending absence checked before body. Body signature Result<(),E> permits only unit success; no success value can directly carry live owners out. This is a trusted composition contract, not a proof against arbitrary external state captured by a malicious body.

Original acquired lease immediately enters a unique armed ManuallyDrop guard. Body Err leaves guard armed; panic unwind also traverses guard. Guard takes original exactly once and calls retain_until_exit, moving the same raw capabilities into the preclaimed bounded ledger without native Close/reopen/new ownership. Sticky FAULTED and claim retention refuse replacement operations until actual process exit.

Only Ok(()) disarms/takes the original lease for checked try_release. A close error sets sticky failed state; the ordinary lease destructor then retains remaining original handles in the same ledger. No success result or new replacement owner is manufactured.

Wrapper encloses existing full run_at lifetime, including data preparation, InstanceGuard, host and App. Existing shutdown_complete requires stopping, writer/backup fence, finished pool/shell, closed physical audio and no terminate_required. Native-host failure/incomplete shutdown terminates the actual process; normal path requests pool stop, checks completion and joins, then all inner locals drop before unit body return. Existing inherited destructor/native-adapter behavior was not newly qualified by this review.

Production repair wrapper encloses run_at_with and its actual coordinator/worker shutdown. Host ending early is not sufficient: it continues polling until exit_ready. A final body error retains the startup gate via the helper; successful body return follows the existing joined/physical-worker path.

A production --repair child is spawned only after run_at_inner returns and its data/instance owners leave scope. Parent startup lease remains during spawn; child independently acquires the same shared startup gate before its data lookup. If maintenance wins a genuine gap after parent release but before child acquisition, child fails before data access. There is no implicit maintenance ownership transfer or unguarded child storage path.

Existing isolated application probe still calls run_at(paths,true,true), and repair diagnostics use run_at_with directly. They do not call installation_startup wrapper or claim production gate. The !probe condition short-circuits the production DataPaths lookup used only to authorize repair handoff. Gate-specific tests use private test leaf identities.

Shared leases allow cooperative startup readers; maintenance exclusive share0 cannot overlap any live original shared gate. Existing data-root InstanceGuard remains additional normal-instance protection. Startup helper adds no login/identity challenge to public desktop functions. MSI hooks/broker, installed baseline upgrade and complete P5-03/Q13 remain outside this slice.

Four new helper scenarios in source exercise body not entered under maintenance, shared ownership during success body, body error retention while child stays alive, and caught-panic retention while original child stays alive. Retained Child objects are waited before fixtures are cleaned; exact child selection still matches actual module path. Total17 test functions is source inventory only, not execution evidence.
